tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should support mobile emulation
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should support landscape emulation
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulate should work
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulate should work twice on about:blank
reason: Emulates a phone: a mobile viewport, which Firefox and stock WebKit refuse Unsupported (emulation.viewport.mobile). The matrix row says the option is present, which covers only the device scale factor

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should support touch emulation
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should be detectable by Modernizr
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should detect touch when applying viewport with touches
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulate should support clicking
reason: Turns touch on with page.emulate({ touch: true }), which Firefox and stock WebKit refuse Unsupported (emulation.touch). The clicking test and the others also need the phone's mobile viewport

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should update media queries when resolution changes
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.viewport should load correct pictures when emulation dpr
reason: A device scale factor other than 1 for the viewport, which stock WebKit refuses Unsupported (emulation.viewport.mobile and its scale)

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaType should work
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaFeatures should work with forced-colors
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaFeatures should work with prefers-contrast
reason: Firefox can't emulate media (Emulation's backend table: emulation.media), so the page's media queries keep the browser's own values. The matrix row says Strider has this; it has it on Chromium and stock WebKit only

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaType should throw in case of bad argument
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaFeatures should throw in case of bad argument
reason: Puppeteer checks the media type and the feature name at run time and throws for another value. Strider's Emulation.Media is typed, so a value outside the union doesn't compile, and the call has no run-time error to check

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaFeatures should work
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateMediaFeatures should work with prefers-reduced-transparency
reason: Sets media features Strider's Emulation.Media doesn't name: color-gamut, and prefers-reduced-transparency. Strider has reducedMotion, colorScheme, contrast, forcedColors, and the media type; the matrix row covers those

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateTimezone should work
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateTimezone should support timezone offset
reason: Stock WebKit takes the time zone at launch, before a context's options reach it, so page.emulate({ timezone }) is refused Unsupported (emulation.timezone)

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateLocale should work
reason: Stock WebKit's MiniBrowser takes its language from nothing it's given, so page.emulate({ locale }) is refused Unsupported (emulation.locale)

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateVisionDeficiency should work
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateVisionDeficiency should throw for invalid vision deficiencies
reason: Simulates a vision deficiency (protanopia, blurred vision, reduced contrast and the rest). Strider's emulation has no vision deficiency field, and the matrix has no row for one; the nearest row is Page.emulateMedia

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateNetworkConditions should support offline
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateNetworkConditions should support offline without additional parameters
reason: Takes the page offline with page.emulate({ network: "offline" }), which stock WebKit refuses Unsupported (emulation.network.offline; its inspector has no Emulation domain)

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateNetworkConditions should change navigator.connection.effectiveType
[emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateCPUThrottling should change the CPU throttling rate successfully
reason: Throttles the network or the CPU with page.emulate({ network } or { cpuSlowdown }), which Firefox and stock WebKit refuse Unsupported (emulation.network.throttling and emulation.cpuSlowdown). The matrix has no row for either; the nearest row is the network emulation one

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateFocusedPage should emulate focus
reason: Focus emulation (focus: "emulated") is Chromium's: Firefox and stock WebKit refuse it Unsupported (emulation.focus), as the Playwright emulation-focus port records

tests: [emulation.test] Emulation Page.emulateFocusedPage should reset focus
decision: The library changes nothing the caller didn't ask for
reason: Switches focus emulation off on a page that already has it. Strider's focus emulation is set when a page or context is made and holds for its life, and no call turns it off again
